quarterly_data.quarter: Perplexity press release: Open-sourcing SPACE, the sandbox platform behind Computer (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Perplexity open-sourced SPACE, the in-house sandbox platform behind its Computer agent (isolated code execution, pause and resume, recovery, session branching), which in July replaced the commercially available sandbox provider it had used; Computer launched in February.
